address: 港汇恒隆广场 (Grand Gateway 66), 徐汇区, 上海市 — B1 (B105K)
description_en: Gelato store known for matcha gelato with different concentration levels. Located near the entrance facing metro line 9. Another well-known matcha spot nearby is 麻布屋 (Azabuya).
description_zh: 以抹茶口味闻名的意式冰淇淋店，抹茶浓度可选。靠近面向地铁9号线的入口。附近还有另一家知名抹茶店麻布屋(Azabuya)。
